svg.title: Create a callout that’s yours. — Callout Studio
svg.desc: The actual new-callout editor opens on Idea with the idea and spark IDs, a Purple palette, and a lightbulb icon, showing its real color and icon controls, geometry settings, and live three-format preview. Production components in phone layout with synthetic content on a purple promotional background, without a simulated Obsidian workspace. Mobile store artwork, 900 by 1600 pixels.

text.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
